tools.why.card1.desc: All 6 photo editors run in your browser via WebAssembly (libheif-js, canvas API). Your photos are not uploaded to any server — not for processing, not for AI training, not for anything.
tools.why.card1.title: Files never leave your device
tools.why.card2.desc: Open a tool, use it, close the tab. Nothing follows you. The only account prompt is at the AI video order step, and that is just to deliver your files.
tools.why.card2.title: No signup, no email, no funnel
tools.why.card3.desc: Every photo tool here can hand off to the AI wedding video generator. 8 styles at each style's own rate in 9 minutes, in 11 languages. The full set of 8 styles is — and you can skip the photo editing entirely.
tools.why.card3.title: Same photos → AI wedding video
tools.why.card4.desc: All 13 tools are touch-friendly. The seating chart maker is easier on a large screen because of the drag-drop floor plan, but every other tool works on a phone.
tools.why.card4.title: Mobile, tablet, desktop — all work
